chapters.label: The free kick, live
chapters.text: Old Trafford, 2001. England are losing to Greece, and time is almost up. One last free kick, thirty yards out. David Beckham steps up... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, from behind. It rises over the wall, curls left and dips into the top corner. The keeper has no chance!

chapters.label: Two-all!
chapters.text: Two-all! Beckham runs to the fans, arms wide. England are going to the World Cup!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Lean over the ball and strike across it with the inside of your foot. It spins, rises over the wall, and curls down.
